prompt:
Create ONE animation cel for a 2D fighter. Use the supplied Pokemon Generation 5 Black and White animated sprite as strict identity, proportions, palette and pixel-art reference. Hitmonlee, tan brown oval-bodied fighting Pokemon, eyes set in dark triangular sockets directly in torso, no mouth and no separate head, exactly two arms and two long segmented spring-like legs with three-toed feet.
Draw this precise pose: High Jump Kick strike: diagonal flying knee and foot kick high toward RIGHT, one leg fully extended, other folded back, whole body visible. Creature body only, effects will be separate. Face RIGHT.
The character faces RIGHT in three-quarter side view throughout. Preserve the same body volume, head size, pixel scale, markings and lighting as the reference. Changes in silhouette must come from articulation. Render true coarse Nintendo DS sprite pixel art, chunky square pixels, dark pixel outline, restrained flat-color clusters, hard stair-step edges. Full body and all extremities visible. Center the complete character with ample margin. One character only. Perfect uniform chroma MAGENTA background RGB(255,0,255). No text, grid, labels, multiple panels, shadows, scenery, motion trails or attack effects. No soft painting or antialiasing. The output is an enlarged pixel sprite, retaining roughly 60-80 logical pixels of character detail. The first image is the canonical idle reference and the second, if supplied, is the original palette reference.
